title: Minter, Ravens noncommittal on whether CB Humphrey will return to face Texans

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Minter, Ravens noncommittal on whether CB Humphrey will return to face Texans
sources.description: A day after he was a healthy scratch in a 35-33 loss at the Panthers following a derogatory comment he made about the city of Baltimore, the Ravens were noncommittal on whether cornerback Marlon Humphrey would play Sunday against the Texans.
